prompt_en: A complex, photorealistic nighttime environmental portrait at a remote high-altitude desert radio observatory. One unmistakably adult East Asian woman, visually informed by the supplied reference, has an oval face, ivory complexion, almond brown eyes, straight brows, a delicate nose, and softly defined lips. Her face is unobscured in a medium-wide three-quarter view, and her bilateral twin-tail hairstyle is fully readable from crown to ends: two visible left and right scalp tie points clearly anchor the hairstyle; two separately trailing gathered hair bundles descend clearly behind her shoulders; the two gathered sides remain spatially distinct around one adult head; scalp hair visibly converges into each tie point with continuous gathered roots; loose side locks and face-framing tendrils do not substitute for the tied gathered structure. She calibrates the array by turning the vernier on a tripod-mounted phase beacon while five diagnostic traces converge on a rugged field monitor. Behind her, synchronized radio dishes slew toward a calibrator quasar above wind-rippled salt flats. Cool service rim light and warm monitor glow reveal her face, hands, instrument contact, desert dust, and dish silhouettes.
